title: Trust & Security | ContextMint
description: ContextMint security posture — local-first default, optional BYOK, shared on-prem server pilots, RBAC, and audit trails.

hero.title: Local-first trust you can defend in a pilot
hero.lead: Enterprise buyers need proof before APIs. Local-first architecture, human Gates 1 & 2, optional shared-server OIDC, and operator audit trails — the trust layer behind v1.0. Blast-radius SKU and SOC 2 certification remain on the roadmap.

pillars.title: Local-first architecture
pillars.text: Code indexing, embeddings, and retrieval run on your infrastructure. Ollama processes locally — source never required to leave your device on the Developer tier.

pillars.title: Human verification gates
pillars.textBefore: Context Lens before inference. Patch preview and apply gates before repo writes. AI narrates; humans approve material changes. Graph-computed blast radius and drift SKUs are

pillars.title: RBAC & agent governance
pillars.textAfter: scoped read tools for MCP agents on the Verification Engine roadmap. v1.0 enforces human Gates 1 & 2 in the IDE — no silent writes.

pillars.title: Audit trail
pillars.textBefore: Operator actions and support-bundle exports for pilot and security reviews. SOC 2 Type II certification and dedicated evidence collectors are on the

pillars.title: Optional cloud (BYOK)
pillars.text: Cloud LLM routing is opt-in and disabled by default. Provider API keys live in VS Code secrets on the developer machine — never in server config. Assembled context is redacted before any approved cloud dispatch. Local Ollama remains the default for sovereign workflows.

controls.title: Enterprise controls
items: SSO via OIDC on the shared-server pilot path (Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Keycloak, and other compliant IdPs)
Role-based access — viewer, dev, admin per workspace (shared-server path)
Self-hosted API server — Docker Compose or Helm for regulated pilots
Optional BYOK cloud routing with egress redaction (off by default)
Operator audit / support-bundle export; Redis-backed rate limiting on team server
Air-gapped Helm, tenant isolation, and fabric evidence ledger — roadmap / packaging
